name: PIONEER: Studies of Rare Pion Decays (proposal)

summary.plain: The PIONEER collaboration’s proposal to the Paul Scherrer Institute for a next-generation rare pion decay experiment.
summary.technical: PIONEER proposal (PSI R-22-01.1): R_e/mu and pion beta decay measurements with an active LGAD target and a 3pi sr, 25 X0 calorimeter at the PSI pion beam.
